label: fingerprint track
purpose: Per-window diversity-regime fingerprint with rank-equivalence regime IDs, switch markers (▲ return / ▼ terminal / · brief), fragment-proportions treemap, architecture-scenario verdict (stable / recombinant_tract / two_adjacent / nested / complex / insufficient). Cartridge implementation of HANDOFF_6.
input_contract: atlasState.inversion.fingerprint_track_state = { fingerprint_result: mgl_fingerprinter output, candidate_label?: string, regime_colors_by_id?: Object<number,string>, window_labels?: Array<string> }

panels.purpose: horizontal regime strip across the candidate (canvas)
▲ return / ▼ terminal / · brief switches above the strip
architecture-scenario verdict in the header (stable / recombinant_tract / two_adjacent / nested / complex / insufficient)
treemap-style plot of regime fragment proportions

deferred: Genomic coordinates axis (start_bp / end_bp) — needs window metadata wired through atlasState; currently uses window indices
Cross-panel linkage with tree / PCA / heatmap (separate commit once HANDOFF_2's candidate-mode slot is wired)
Stage 1 in-browser π / dXY / Fst from Beagle — separate primitive
subdir_files: renderer.js — canvas painter for fingerprint strip + switch markers
proportions.js — treemap-style regime fragment proportions plot
selection.js — hover (window cell or switch marker) + click-to-toggle selected window set
adapters_used: unknown — reads pre-computed fingerprint_result from atlasState
